title: Boarding houses, dormitories, fraternity houses and sorority houses in Group R-1.
officialText: Accessible units and Type B+NYC units shall be provided in boarding houses, dormitories, fraternity houses and sorority houses in Group R-1 occupancies in accordance with Sections 1107.6.1.4.1 and 1107.6.1.4.2.
